recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a crisp white suit, positioned against a textured white paneled door. The lighting is directional, creating soft shadows that define the subject's facial structure and the wood grain of the background. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and sophisticated with a cool-toned color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's white attire blending into the white architectural background
High-contrast shadows defining the jawline and facial features
Left-aligned blue and navy typography contrasting with the neutral scene
Diagonal line of the suit lapel leading the eye toward the subject's face
coreInvariants: Three-quarter head turn looking away from the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes looking off-camera, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold blue text on the left, moves across the shoulder to the face, then follows the gaze toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners and between the subject's arm and torso.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white and off-white (suit and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (hair, shadows, and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value; the only saturated elements are the blue text characters.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a strictly cool-toned white balance

composition.relationshipToImage: Aligned with the left edge of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and color contrast for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, geometric feel of the primary display text.
Provides a clean, neutral alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio portrait of a man with short hair in a three-quarter profile, wearing a white blazer and white shirt. The background should be a white wooden door with vertical and horizontal paneling. Use cool-toned lighting to create soft shadows on the face and background texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned uppercase sans-serif text in the upper left quadrant. The top line should be large and bold in a cornflower blue color. The second line should be smaller and in a dark navy blue color, perfectly aligned with the left edge of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting cool-toned and directional?
Is the text left-aligned and uppercase?
Does the white suit contrast subtly with the white background?
Is the subject looking away from the camera?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for typography
Intensity of background wood grain texture
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue text is legible against the white background.
Check that the shadows on the face are soft and not harsh.
Verify the paneling texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the two-tone blue color scheme for the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + White Architectural Background + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography + Cool-Toned High-Key Lighting
